data: In the leftmost plot, what is the approximate identification rate of the black line when Alpha is 0.8?

The leftmost plot shows the identification rate as a function of Alpha. The black line represents the identification rate. When Alpha is approximately 0.8, the identification rate of the black line appears to be around 75%. This can be estimated visually by observing the position of the black line on the y-axis at the corresponding value of Alpha.
